caption: The drawing features a central figure wearing a long, blue robe with yellow accents, holding a smaller figure dressed in red on her left arm. A green palm branch or frond is held in the right hand of the central figure. Both figures have light skin and dark hair, and each has a halo; the larger figure's halo is red and circular. The scene is framed by red and blue drapery at the top, gathered in scalloped folds with red dots on a white background. There are two vertical floral objects, each with green stems and red flowers, flanking the main figures at the bottom left and right corners of the image. The background is mostly pale tan, with the framing and outlines rendered in black. The image is bordered with a thin red line.
title: Panel from Altar Piece of San Antonio
